coordination.limits: Operator tool window; exact unreadable dockerd/containerd/gpg identities remain unobserved. No universal inactivity or right to inspect their environments/signal them. All known task compilers/tool users are stopped.

processObservation.scope: Readable exact executable/cwd/argv/maps/fd observations; no future-launch exclusion or universal daemon-operation proof

beforeManifest.scope: Exact known trees historically contain only ordinary directories/single-link files; symlink/hardlink surprises refuse, never normalize.

lastProcessObservation.scope: Readable exact executable/cwd/argv/maps/fd observations; no future-launch exclusion or universal daemon-operation proof

metadataLimits: Bytes/mode/uid/gid/mtime and absence of symlink/hardlink surprises verified. Cross-filesystem inode/ctime/atime not preserved. Disk observations not resource or performance acceptance.
